## 💡 Feature Summary

A short, one-line description of the feature.

## Problem It Solves

What challenge or friction point does this address? Which area of Lumina does it affect?

- [ ] Learn Feed (Reels)
- [ ] Quiz / MCQ Engine
- [ ] Flashcard / Active Recall
- [ ] Progress / Analytics
- [ ] AI Extraction Pipeline (Python Scripts)
- [ ] Firebase / Backend Architecture
- [ ] Onboarding / Setup Experience
- [ ] Accessibility
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you imagine this feature working. Include mockups, diagrams, or rough code sketches if helpful.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative approaches you've thought about, and why you're proposing this one.

## Contribution Interest

- [ ] I'd like to work on this myself and open a PR
- [ ] I'm suggesting this for someone else to pick up
- [ ] I'm open to collaborating with another contributor

## Additional Context

Links to relevant research, similar implementations in other apps, or related issues.
